attributes.title: ERA5 Hourly Global Reanalysis - chunked for temporal analysis
attributes.summary: ERA5 is the fifth generation ECMWF atmospheric reanalysis of the global climate covering the period from January 1940 to the present. ERA5 provides hourly estimates of a large number of atmospheric, land and oceanic climate variables at 0.25° resolution. Data are served here as an Analysis-Ready Cloud-Optimized (ARCO) Zarr store, updated daily. Recent timesteps carry expver=0005 (ERA5T, near-realtime, ~5 days behind real time) and are overwritten with expver=0001 (final ERA5) approximately two months after the reference month.
